newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes little changed ahead of poll.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes little changed ahead of poll.

text.p: The bearish trend that has characterised trading on the Ghana Stock Exchange for the last couple of months continued on Wednesday as prices closed little changed in thin volume.
The all-share index closed up 0.17 points at 362.05 points, compared with Monday's 361.88.
Traders said, however, they expected a rebound in activity after presidential and parliamentary elections on December 7.
Big buyers have been holding off in the runup to the elections, which should signal the direction of Ghana's economic policy for the next four years, traders said.
